description: This file defines the NullArgumentException class, a custom exception used within the Apache Commons Math library to signal the presence of null arguments in method calls. It extends MathIllegalArgumentException and provides constructors for creation with localized error messages.

classes.name: NullArgumentException
classes.description: A specialized exception thrown when a null argument is encountered where it is not allowed, signaling a precondition violation without extending NullPointerException.

methods.name: NullArgumentException
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a localized message indicating null is not allowed.

methods.name: NullArgumentException(Localizable pattern, Object... arguments)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor accepting a message pattern and arguments for localized error messaging.
